newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atlas terminates pact with Hong Kong firm.
newsitem.headline: Atlas terminates pact with Hong Kong firm.

text.p: Atlas Consolidated Mining and Development Corp said on Friday it had terminated a preliminary agreement with Hong Kong's Resource Engineering and Finance Corp (Refcorp) for the lease of its copper mine on the central Philippine island of Cebu.
Refcorp had failed to comply with certain commitments under the memorandum of understanding and had failed to submit evidence of sufficient funding for the project, Atlas said in a statement.
Atlas clinched a deal with Refcorp in July 1996 after failing to close an arrangement with Astron Ltd of Australia for the rehabilitation of the copper mine.
The Atlas mine was shut in January 1994 because of soft copper prices and steep production costs.
Rehabilitation of the mine, which may take from five to six months, is estimated to cost $65 million.
The copper mine had an output of 16,000 tonnes of ore per day before it was closed.
